solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Actor, hipster, made space for musicians

indicators.note: made is read as 'made into something else', so the letters of the two words are reworked

explanation.surface: A trendy performer clears a room so the band has somewhere to play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made' signals the anagram of ACTOR HIPSTER; ORCHESTRA is also a well-worn anagram of CARTHORSE.
explanation.definitionFit: The sunken area in front of a theatre stage is where the accompanying instrumentalists sit.

clue.text: Make a tinkling noise to serve as a reminder?

definitions.meaning: literally sounding a small chime, as at a door
the idiom for something seeming familiar and jogging the memory

explanation.surface: Asks whether jingling something might be a way of jogging someone's memory.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to sound familiar, while the literal sense is pressing a doorbell or shaking a handbell.

clue.text: More reckless, eats layer of cake!

parts.note: to have a meal is to eat it, so eats gives has
a wedding cake is built in tiers

explanation.surface: Someone rashly wolfs down a slice of gateau.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting in haste means acting without due care, so a more hurried person is the more rash one.

parts.note: something not bent is straight; also, not bent means honest
flush means level, as a surface flush with another

explanation.surface: Describes something both unbowed and even, like a ruler laid on a table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hand' looks like a body part to be described by the rest; it is a poker hand.
explanation.definitionFit: In poker, five consecutive cards of the same suit form one of the strongest possible deals.

indicators.note: in a down clue the first part sits on top of the next piece
extraordinary suggests the word race is put out of its ordinary order

explanation.surface: A reporter is asked to write up a remarkable contest in a single sheet.
explanation.definitionFit: To summarise is to go briefly over the main points again, a short recapitulation.

indicators.note: turned over says the word for lid is flipped end to end

parts.note: a lid is a top, as on a jar

explanation.surface: A saucepan cover gets flipped upside down.
explanation.definitionFit: A pan and a pot are both cooking vessels, near synonyms in the kitchen.

clue.text: Ability to write story on New Testament

indicators.note: in a down clue the first part sits on top of the next piece

explanation.surface: Describes having the gift to compose a narrative based on the Gospels.
explanation.definitionFit: A natural gift or aptitude for something is a talent, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Admitting hot finally, scarf put away

indicators.note: admitting means letting something in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a sash is a band of cloth worn round the body, like a scarf

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of the word hot

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to feeling warm and finally packs their scarf away.
explanation.definitionFit: To hide something away for safekeeping is to squirrel it, a synonym for storing secretly.

clue.text: Cask of beer is for African capital

parts.note: a tun is a large cask for beer or wine

explanation.surface: A barrel of ale is said to be destined for a city in Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital city of Tunisia, on the Mediterranean coast of North Africa.

indicators.note: rewritten says the letters of article are set down again in a new order

explanation.surface: A piece of journalism is redone in time for a show.
explanation.definitionFit: A concert given by a solo musician or small group is a type of performance.

clue.text: Language produced as I wash off cut lip

indicators.note: off in the sense of wrong or awry tells us the letters of I wash are jumbled
cut says the word lip loses its last letter

explanation.surface: Someone describes washing away blood after splitting their lip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'produced as' is linking text; 'off' is the anagram signal working on I WASH.
explanation.definitionFit: A Bantu tongue widely spoken in East Africa, a lingua franca of Kenya and Tanzania.

clue.text: Order feathers on splitting quill, perhaps?

indicators.note: splitting says one piece breaks the other apart by sitting inside it

parts.note: a quill is an example of a pen, hence perhaps

explanation.surface: A bird arranges its plumage around a feather used for writing.
explanation.definitionFit: A bird grooming and tidying its plumage with its beak is doing exactly this.

clue.text: Group gets home drunk around one

indicators.note: around says the scrambled letters wrap round the next piece
drunk suggests the words gets home are reeling into disorder

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A merrymaker staggers back to the house holding someone up.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram of GETS HOME goes 'around' I.
explanation.definitionFit: A Scottish reel for eight dancers, or any set of eight, is a group.

clue.text: Someone from this planet: large and thin, weirdly!

indicators.note: weirdly suggests the letters of large and thin are put in an odd order

explanation.surface: An alien observer remarks on a human who is oddly both big and skinny.
explanation.definitionFit: A person native to our world, as an alien in science fiction would put it.

clue.text: From Sicily, say, I ain't worried about Mr Capone!

indicators.note: about says the scrambled letters go round the next piece
worried means troubled or shaken, so the letters of I ain't are disturbed

parts.note: Al Capone was the Chicago gangster

explanation.surface: A Sicilian mobster insists he is not anxious about the famous gangster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' marks Sicily as an example; the anagram of I AIN'T goes 'about' AL.
explanation.definitionFit: Sicily is a region of the Mediterranean country, so a Sicilian is an example of its people.

indicators.note: in a down clue up says the pieces are read from bottom to top

parts.note: set means ready, as in ready, steady, go
an arc is a curved line

explanation.surface: An instruction to get prepared and queue for packing cases.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses SETARC; 'line' wants to mean queue, but it is the curve.
explanation.definitionFit: Wooden shipping containers, slatted packing cases, are a type of box.

definitions.meaning: to defeat utterly, as to squash a rebellion
a brief passion for someone, often adolescent

explanation.surface: Suggests someone being swept away mercilessly by a passion.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is to subdue an opponent completely; the other is a schoolgirl's sudden fondness.

indicators.note: messed up means disordered, so the letters of loser are scrambled

explanation.surface: An unlucky actor botched the characters he was given.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor plays characters in a play, each of which is called a part.

definitions.meaning: an old-fashioned word for excellent or splendid
to grow or rise, as a river does in flood

explanation.surface: A cheerful exclamation followed by a demand for growth.
explanation.definitionFit: An old-fashioned exclamation for excellent, and also a verb meaning to grow bigger.

definitions.meaning: more even, less bumpy, as a comparative adjective

explanation.surface: Suggests applying plaster generously to get an even finish.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as decorating; one sense is praising excessively, the other is the comparative of level.
explanation.definitionFit: Overpraising someone is the verb sense; the comparative of an even, level surface is the other.

indicators.note: Somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A grim, severe picture of something regrettable.
explanation.definitionFit: A picturesque grouping of people, as in a staged picture, is a scene.

indicators.note: unfinished says the word for bed is cut short of its final letter

parts.note: a bunk is a narrow bed, as on a ship

explanation.surface: Someone is half-way through a pastry in bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A small sweet bread roll, often with currants, is a kind of cake.

indicators.note: cooks as in cooks the books, falsifying, so the letters of solid are tampered with

explanation.surface: Reliable chefs are the ones people look up to.
explanation.definitionFit: Figures who are worshipped or greatly admired, such as pop stars, are objects of adoration.

parts.note: a single is a record with one track per side, as opposed to an LP
handed means passed over or delivered

explanation.surface: A musician's record was released as a one-off performance.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something alone, unaided by others, is acting on one's own.
